description: Norwegian public procurement notices from Doffin and TED, filterable by CPV code, region (county or NUTS), deadline and buyer. Costs 0.01 USDC per successful call (x402, Base). Errors are free.

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix; up to 10, comma-separated. 72 matches all IT services.

deadline_from.description: Deadline on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

deadline_to.description: Deadline on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

open.description: Only tenders whose deadline has not passed.

q.description: Words in the title or description.

region.description: NUTS code (NO, NO08, NO081) or 2-digit county number (fylkesnummer).

name: search_tenders
title: Search public tenders
